Thus, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no immediate risk. The operations that involve Git or building occur only within the build functions, which are not executed during this step. The use of `${_pydeps[@]/#/python-}` is a standard bash parameter expansion to prefix dependencies and is safe in this context.
</details>
